raw_response: {"sentences":[{"text":"From the Conciergerie, make your way on to Sainte-Chapelle, about a four-minute walk away.","source_id":"GLUE_NAV","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":3},{"text":"Picture a king walking barefoot through the streets, dressed as a penitent, cradling a bundle of relics in his own arms.","source_id":"a185186e-905e-4066-b8d3-b0cfe52c14fe","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"For the last stage of the journey Louis carried them himself, and that very scene glows today in the Relics of the Passion window on the chapel's south side.","source_id":"a185186e-905e-4066-b8d3-b0cfe52c14fe","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"The relics had reached Paris in August 1239, brought up from Venice by two Dominican friars, and the king marked their arrival with a week-long celebration.","source_id":"a185186e-905e-4066-b8d3-b0cfe52c14fe","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"What was worth all that? A piece of the Holy Cross and the Crown of Thorns, which Louis bought from Baudouin II, the last emperor of Constantinople, desperate for funds to defend his city.","source_id":"9bf472f0-97b0-4c74-8e0d-c304ca44edd1","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"The price tells you everything about his priorities: 135,000 livres for the relics, another 100,000 for the silver Grand-Chasse to hold them, and just 40,000 to build and glaze the chapel around them.","source_id":"a185186e-905e-4066-b8d3-b0cfe52c14fe","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"The architects — Pierre de Montreuil, or maybe Jean de Chelles — were handed an unusual brief: make a chapel that looked as light and lacy as a reliquary itself.","source_id":"9bf472f0-97b0-4c74-8e0d-c304ca44edd1","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"It took barely five years.","source_id":"9bf472f0-97b0-4c74-8e0d-c304ca44edd1","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"And the result went stunningly beyond anything expected.","source_id":"9bf472f0-97b0-4c74-8e0d-c304ca44edd1","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"There are actually two chapels stacked here — the plain lower one for the servants, while the court climbed a spiral staircase to the upper chapel.","source_id":"6ae3bf26-cf36-414f-a10f-809bba4acc3c","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"Up top, the walls are almost pure stained glass, held aloft by powerful supports the medieval builders cleverly disguised as clusters of pencil-thin columns so the stone seems to vanish.","source_id":"6ae3bf26-cf36-414f-a10f-809bba4acc3c","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"When the sun pours through, the glowing blues and reds scatter across the interior like a swarm of brilliant butterflies.","source_id":"6ae3bf26-cf36-414f-a10f-809bba4acc3c","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"Count them and you'd reach 1,113 panels, two-thirds of them original and the rest from a nineteenth-century restoration.","source_id":"0c35674e-7d27-49ad-bdc6-1bbff4c3eec0","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"Together they run nearly the whole Bible — Genesis on the north wall, the Passion of Christ at the east end, the story of these very relics on the south, and the Apocalypse blazing in the rose window.","source_id":"0c35674e-7d27-49ad-bdc6-1bbff4c3eec0","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"The men who made all this between 1242 and 1248? Their names are gone.","source_id":"f9ed43cd-ef11-4623-b9aa-cc855cecf438","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"But the art historian Louis Grodecki teased out three separate workshops just from their styles.","source_id":"f9ed43cd-ef11-4623-b9aa-cc855cecf438","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"The first shaped the apse and most of the north wall, with supple forms and simplified features.","source_id":"f9ed43cd-ef11-4623-b9aa-cc855cecf438","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"The second, the Master of the Ezekiel Window, gave the Ezekiel, Daniel and Kings windows their elongated figures and angular drapery.","source_id":"f9ed43cd-ef11-4623-b9aa-cc855cecf438","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"And the third, the Master of Judith and Esther, added the window of Job, with subtler faces that feel lifted straight from an illuminated manuscript.","source_id":"f9ed43cd-ef11-4623-b9aa-cc855cecf438","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"Then came the Revolution.","source_id":"9bf472f0-97b0-4c74-8e0d-c304ca44edd1","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"The silver-and-gold reliquary that once held the Crown of Thorns was sent to the Mint, yet its contents — genuine or not — miraculously survived and rest today at Notre-Dame.","source_id":"9bf472f0-97b0-4c74-8e0d-c304ca44edd1","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"Even the standard-bearers of the Revolutionary ideal, it seems, didn't dare to tamper with the holiest of Christian symbols.","source_id":"9bf472f0-97b0-4c74-8e0d-c304ca44edd1","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"The chapel got no such mercy.","source_id":"9bf472f0-97b0-4c74-8e0d-c304ca44edd1","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"It became a flour store, then a depot for court archives, so run-down that by 1847 it still carried a sign reading 'National property, for sale.'","source_id":"9bf472f0-97b0-4c74-8e0d-c304ca44edd1","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"Enlightened voices finally called in Viollet-le-Duc, Lassus and others to rescue it, and 720 of the 1,134 original stained-glass scenes were preserved.","source_id":"9bf472f0-97b0-4c74-8e0d-c304ca44edd1","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"These days the chapel fills with classical concerts, and a ticket bought a day or so ahead spares you the long queue.","source_id":"0c35674e-7d27-49ad-bdc6-1bbff4c3eec0","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3}]}
